# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: Guest Worker Administration
# Generated by tools/guest_workers/build_dashboard.py.
mdcw_gw_ui_recruit_25000 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			mdcw_gw_ui_can_recruit_25000 = yes
		}
		add_political_power = -75
		if = {
			limit = {
				mdcw_gw_ui_request_available_25000 = yes
			}
			save_event_target_as = mdcw_gw_receiver
			random_owned_state = {
				limit = {
					is_controlled_by = PREV
				}
				save_event_target_as = mdcw_gw_destination_state
			}
			var:ROOT.gw_ui_partner = {
				random_owned_state = {
					limit = {
						is_controlled_by = PREV
						state_population > 25000
					}
					save_event_target_as = mdcw_gw_origin_state
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = mdcw_gw_request_pending
			set_variable = {
				mdcw_gw_partner = ROOT.gw_ui_partner
			}
			set_variable = {
				mdcw_gw_pending_tier = 1
			}
			set_variable = {
				mdcw_gw_pending_pp = 75
			}
			add_to_variable = {
				gw_ui_dirty = 1
			}
			country_event = {
				id = mdcw_guest_workers.90
				days = 17
			}
			var:ROOT.gw_ui_partner = {
				save_event_target_as = mdcw_gw_sender
				set_country_flag = mdcw_gw_offer_pending
				set_country_flag = {
					flag = mdcw_gw_offer_window_open
					days = 19
				}
				set_variable = {
					mdcw_gw_partner = ROOT.id
				}
				set_variable = {
					mdcw_gw_pending_tier = 1
				}
				add_to_variable = {
					gw_ui_dirty = 1
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							mdcw_gw_pending_tier = 1
						}
					}
					country_event = {
						id = mdcw_guest_workers.1
						days = 1
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							mdcw_gw_pending_tier = 2
						}
					}
					country_event = {
						id = mdcw_guest_workers.2
						days = 1
					}
				}
				else = {
					country_event = {
						id = mdcw_guest_workers.3
						days = 1
					}
				}
				country_event = {
					id = mdcw_guest_workers.91
					days = 17
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_political_power = 75
		}
	}
}

		if = {
			limit = {

			}
			save_event_target_as = mdcw_gw_receiver
			random_owned_state = {

				}

				random_owned_state = {
					limit = {
						is_controlled_by = PREV

						NOT = {
							state = event_target:mdcw_gw_origin_state

					save_event_target_as = mdcw_gw_origin_state_2

			}
			set_country_flag = mdcw_gw_request_pending
